svg.title: Where the first-call tokens go
svg.desc: Stacked bars showing the composition of each first request. Copilot CLI about 14,877 tokens: system 6,657, tools 8,064, user plus history 156. Claude CLI about 27,217: system 7,015, tools 18,877, skill catalog about 1,094, remainder about 231. Copilot in VS Code 20,598: tool definitions sent on the first request about 9,200 (23 of 56 tools; the other 33 are deferred) plus a single opaque block of about 11,424 for system, skills and workspace context that the export does not separate. On the two CLIs the tool definitions are the largest single component (54.2 percent and 69.4 percent). In VS Code they are not: the 23 sent schemas are about 45 percent, below the folded system-and-context block. The user message is among the smallest parts everywhere.
svg.text: Tool definitions dominate both CLI prefixes
First-call composition in shape tokens. CLI splits read from the request body; VS Code's system/context block is not separable in the export.
Values in legend: Copilot CLI · Claude CLI · Copilot in VS Code.

Tool definitions are the largest block on both CLIs (54.2% of Copilot CLI, 69.4% of Claude CLI). In VS Code only 23 of 56 tools ship first (~9,200 tok, ~45%) — below the folded system+context block (~11,424, ~55%).
VS Code defers 33 tools (loaded via tool_search) and folds system, skills, and workspace context into one opaque block, shown as a single grey segment rather than guessed.
